$comment: SI-assisted: generated with Gemini, reviewed and edited by Elias, Pina, Celina & Esquivel — [PROJECT_NAME] | 3D test payloads validating strictly against contracts/simulation_schema.json. Grounded on NASA PSI BASS-II (PSI-25, DOI: 10.60555/4qc4-de67, CC0-1.0) and NASA/TM-20210011385 (PSI-10 excluded).

safety_copilot.diagnosis: Quiescent 0g regime (gravity_g = 0.0g, airflow_cm_s < 1.0 cm/s). Buoyancy is absent; oxygen transport occurs strictly via slow molecular diffusion, forming a stationary spherical blue flame ball around the acrylic sample.
safety_copilot.suppression_action: Keep cabin ventilation OFF to prevent advective oxygen feeding; apply localized fine water mist or inert N2/CO2 flood into the containment glovebox.
safety_copilot.terrestrial_spinoff: Optical sensor calibration for clean, low-soot blue diffusion flames that evade conventional terrestrial photoelectric smoke detectors.
safety_copilot.scientific_limitations: Direct empirical regime from NASA PSI BASS-II (PSI-25) microgravity glovebox tests. Valid for quiescent/ultra-low forced flow (< 1.0 cm/s) at 1 atm cabin pressure.

nasa_citations.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II (BASS-II)
nasa_citations.finding: Demonstrates spherical, soot-free blue diffusion flame stabilization in microgravity under ultra-low flow conditions.

nasa_citations.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II (BASS-II) Summary Report (Olson et al., 2021)
nasa_citations.finding: Documents low-velocity microgravity spread rates and extinction thresholds for solid PMMA samples.

safety_copilot.diagnosis: Combined partial-gravity buoyancy (0.16g Lunar) and forced cabin ventilation (15.0 cm/s) at 30% O2 stretch the reaction zone into an elongated, radiative soot-heavy orange plume with accelerated surface spread.
safety_copilot.suppression_action: IMMEDIATE CABIN HVAC SHUTOFF (< 2 seconds) to eliminate forced convective O2 supply, followed by cabin pressure reduction or targeted water mist suppression.
safety_copilot.terrestrial_spinoff: High-efficiency HVAC fire-damper automation for aircraft cabins, submarines, and cleanrooms with forced ventilation.
safety_copilot.scientific_limitations: Bounded physical interpolation combining BASS-II forced-flow empirical curves (NASA/TM-20210011385 Table 7.1 & Table A.6) with Saffire exploration atmosphere bounds (NTRS-20170000230 & NTRS-20260001600) scaled for 0.16g Lunar partial buoyancy.

nasa_citations.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II (BASS-II) Summary Report (Olson et al., 2021)
nasa_citations.finding: Table 7.1 & Table A.6: Forced air velocities between 4 and 29 cm/s transition microgravity flames on SIBAL fabric from circular blue domes to elongated luminous plumes with higher spread rates.

nasa_citations.title: Operation and Development Status of the Spacecraft Fire Experiments (Saffire)
nasa_citations.finding: Evaluates SIBAL cotton-fiberglass and PMMA flame spread under spacecraft cabin ventilation and exploration atmospheres relevant to Lunar and Martian habitats.

safety_copilot.diagnosis: Ambient oxygen concentration (13.5% O2) is strictly below the material's Limiting Oxygen Index / Minimum Oxygen Concentration (LOI/MOC = 17.5% O2). Heat losses exceed chemical heat release, quenching the reaction.
safety_copilot.suppression_action: No active extinguishant required; maintain hypoxic atmosphere below 17.5% O2 and vent residual pyrolysis smoke through HEPA/charcoal filtration.
safety_copilot.terrestrial_spinoff: Hypoxic fire-prevention systems (normobaric nitrogen-enriched atmospheres) for server data centers and archival vaults.
safety_copilot.scientific_limitations: Empirical extinction boundary grounded in NASA BASS-II Limiting Oxygen Index (LOI) determinations (NASA/TM-20210011385). Re-ignition remains possible if cabin O2 is restored while the sample core exceeds pyrolysis temperature.

nasa_citations.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II (BASS-II)
nasa_citations.finding: Establishes extinction limits as oxygen concentration and opposed airflow velocity are systematically stepped down until flame quench.

nasa_citations.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II (BASS-II) Summary Report (Olson et al., 2021)
nasa_citations.finding: Defines the Minimum Oxygen Concentration (MOC / LOI) curve below which solid fuel samples self-extinguish in microgravity.
